data.content_ref: inline:Kind: contradiction. 3d82a99f1546 contradicts SRC_004's exp(-Θ(n)) consensus probability by entailing that only the Θ(n^{1/3})-sized 2-core obstructions of SRC_005 are reachable, so the perfect-matching obstructions counted by SRC_004 have exponentially small basins. It is refuted if a positive fraction of the exp(Θ(n)) perfect-matching mixed states have nonvanishing basins under the asynchronous majority update.
